facts: The detailed UK ETS markets guidance covers auctions, secondary-market participation, the Auction Reserve Price and the Cost Containment Mechanism.

Allowance-market operation must remain distinct from the quantity of greenhouse gases physically released by a source.

No parcel greenhouse-gas measurement is created by market guidance.

packages.title: UK ETS maritime: how to comply — scope and status QA
facts: The Environment Agency published UK ETS maritime compliance guidance on 22 June 2026.
The first maritime scheme year runs from 1 July 2026 to 31 December 2026.
Maritime operators monitor carbon dioxide, nitrous oxide and methane emissions within UK ETS scope.
Maritime emissions and allowance surrender relate to maritime activities and are not measurements of land-parcel emissions.
No parcel greenhouse-gas value is inferred from maritime compliance guidance.

packages.title: Voluntary MRV period for waste incineration — scope and status QA
facts: The Environment Agency published guidance for the voluntary monitoring, reporting and verification period for energy-from-waste and waste incineration on 1 January 2026.
The voluntary MRV-only period is intended to prepare eligible operators for future UK ETS expansion to these sectors.
The publication applies to England.
Participation and reporting status must remain distinct from independently measured parcel emissions.
No cadastral parcel emission value is inferred from the voluntary MRV programme.

packages.title: Greenhouse gas reporting conversion factors 2026 — scope and status QA
facts: DESNZ published greenhouse-gas reporting conversion factors for 2026 on 11 June 2026.
The factors are intended to help users calculate and report greenhouse-gas emissions from UK activities in 2026.
The page distinguishes activity-based conversion factors from Defra spend-based emissions multipliers.
Conversion factors are coefficients and are not direct measurements of emissions from a cadastral parcel.
No parcel greenhouse-gas value is produced without valid activity data, an accepted method and parcel binding.
